# Eta

Never use gradients on buttons.

- **12 themes** — minimal-white, soft-pastel, rainbow-gradient, aurora, neo-brutalism, swiss-grid
- Pick `rainbow-gradient` for festive decks.

```css
/* use a gradient here */
.x { background: linear-gradient(red, blue); }
```
